migration.whyPassedOrFailed: Strict alert parity between Sentinel AR and Defender XDR CD was not verified. | Waived with author evidence (FAIL -> WAIVED_WITH_AUTHOR_EVIDENCE): Live alert parity ran on both surfaces for both detections with real mock data: each Analytic Rule and its Custom Detection raised exactly 1 alert, with identical match keys (198.51.100.10 and 198.51.100.20), severity and evidence. Five of seven strict-parity dimensions pass (alertCount, matchKeys, expectedMatches, severity, evidence); all rules and detections were restored to disabled afterwards. Two dimensions do NOT match and are not claimed to: (1) tactics - the Analytic Rules declare two tactics each (Execution+Impact; Impact+DefenseEvasion) while the packaged Custom Detection carries one (V3.1 single-tactic projection of the Custom Detection schema; the omitted tactic is recorded in the packaging log); (2) entities - the Analytic Rules map the plain user name (DstUserName) to an Account entity, while the Custom Detection account mapping requires a UPN or SID, so the converter omits the account mapping; the host/IP/file-hash evidence is equal. A reviewer must decide whether this functional difference is acceptable.
